fullPassage: Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve optimal health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, decreased performance, and ill-health.

"an event in which the sun or moon is blocked by another celestial body"

det.korean: 영영풀이: 태양이나 달이 다른 천체에 의해 가려지는 현상 = eclipse(일식, 월식)

❌ ① equinox(춘분/추분): 낮과 밤의 길이가 같은 시점
❌ ③ orbit(궤도): 천체가 도는 경로
❌ ④ rotation(자전): 천체가 자체 축을 중심으로 회전
